kagome_sst_origin_anchor_classes.count_unit: Kagome SST endpoints connected to Seed

sst_crossover.edit: remove both reciprocal directions of each original SST-SST crossover, then connect both exposed SST endpoints to their corresponding Seed contacts

preexisting_nick.edit: extend the correctly oriented free endpoint to Seed without introducing another cut

linear_continuous.edit: reciprocally cut the same-helix linear bond, then connect the correctly oriented new endpoint to Seed

anchor_classification_policy: classify every candidate against an immutable pre-capture Kagome SST routing snapshot before applying any edit; mutations can create new nicks and must not change later classifications
translated_half_policy: derive from translated SST geometry, active mask, actual base phase, and actual component path; do not copy mappings blindly
capture_extension_policy: trace the contacted SST staple component from bridge base to its endpoint; valid reference lengths are 16 or 32 nt
structure_policy: draw origin-half bridges only; add translated-half captures as export-only sequences
